title: Frequency-Structured Hamiltonian Neural Network for Multi-Timescale Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2603.06354v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning coupled fast and slow dynamics accurately remains challenging for structure-preserving neural models. Hamiltonian Neural Networks preserve a learned Hamiltonian, but their neural parameterizations are susceptible to spectral bias, which favors slowly varying components and can leave fast oscillations poorly resolved. We introduce the Frequency-Structured Hamiltonian Neural Network (FS-HNN), which organizes Hamiltonian learning across temporal frequency scales. FS-HNN learns Hamiltonian components from frequency-filtered views of observed trajectories and combines them nonlinearly into a single scalar Hamiltonian. This enables the model to represent interactions across timescales while conserving the learned energy in continuous time. For PDEs, FS-HNN represents Hamiltonian components as neural functionals and learns a spatial operator, using orthogonal projection to conserve the learned energy. Experiments on ODE and PDE ben

translated_title: 面向多时间尺度动力学的频率结构化哈密顿神经网络
translated_abstract: 对于结构保持型神经模型而言，准确学习快慢耦合的动力学仍然具有挑战性。哈密顿神经网络能够保持所学习到的哈密顿量，但其神经参数化容易受到频谱偏差的影响，这种偏差偏向缓慢变化的分量，可能导致快速振荡无法得到良好的解析。我们提出了频率结构化哈密顿神经网络（FS-HNN），它在时间频率尺度上组织哈密顿学习。FS-HNN 从观测轨迹的频率滤波视图中学习哈密顿分量，并将它们非线性地组合为单个标量哈密顿量。这使得模型能够表示跨时间尺度的相互作用，同时在连续时间内保持所学习到的能量守恒。对于偏微分方程（PDE），FS-HNN 将哈密顿分量表示为神经泛函并学习一个空间算子，利用正交投影来保持所学习到的能量守恒。在 ODE 和 PDE 基准上的实验（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出频率结构化哈密顿神经网络（FS-HNN），通过在时间频率尺度上组织哈密顿学习来克服频谱偏差，从而准确刻画快慢耦合的多时间尺度动力学，并在连续时间内保持能量守恒。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Frequency-Structured Hamiltonian Neural Network (FS-HNN), which organizes Hamiltonian learning across temporal frequency scales to overcome spectral bias, accurately capturing coupled fast-slow multi-timescale dynamics while conserving the learned energy.
